submission.bindingBasis: The same workspaceId (hp4-runtime-equivalent-probe-20260811), the same close request with the same expectedSourceStateDigest (sha256:79bcb09fe7a38dcbb48696f02eb31b8847518cd7599a06f8fca4872e4b135127). Repeating the exact close request with that exact expectedSourceStateDigest is replayable by the owner action contract.
submission.rationale: The owner action contract states that: (1) an exact close tombstone retains sourceStateDigest after physical removal, (2) repeating the exact close request with the same expectedSourceStateDigest is replayable, and (3) exact replay returned already_closed/removed=false in the live probe. The transport observation indicates the original close may have committed but the caller did not receive a trustworthy response — this is the classic at-least-once delivery ambiguity. Replaying the exact close with the same digest is idempotent and replayable, so it converges the original close without closing a different later world state (the expectedSourceStateDigest is unchanged) and without inventing a second effect (already_closed semantics). This satisfies the intended consequence without binding to any planning-time state that might be stale, and without inventing any API not in the owner contract.
